summary_en: Introduces label-free deep-ultraviolet polarization photoacoustic imaging for recognizing cell-division states and assessing tumor aggressiveness. By exploiting polarization sensitivity to microstructural anisotropy, the method produces distinct responses associated with mitotic structural changes and enables stain-free mapping of proliferative activity and tumor microstructure. It is directly relevant to computational and multimodal photoacoustic imaging.
